Variance equals the accuracy of a later classifier

q: The first principal component (PC1) is the line through the origin along which...

q: Which formula does the deck use for the covariance of x and y?

The mean of each feature
The eigenvalues of S
Zeros, since a feature has no covariance with itself

n × n, with n the number of samples
n × p

why: PCA chases variance; a feature measured in large units has huge variance and would dominate PC1. Standardising (z-score) first puts features on equal footing.
